recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: peak heatwave pressing europe into its hottest stretch
long-horizon OCR swallowing whole documents in one pass
the coming loop — automation feeding back into itself
corporate clouds thinning as giant workforces quietly dissolve
san francisco overcast holding june cool at thirteen degrees
stutter-house pulses cutting through dream-pop haze

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap stutter beats as waveform fragments snap into place along a foggy boardwalk — each clean loop peels back the overcast.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: locking an 8-bar loop brightens the sky one shade — chase the full sunrise in under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs, ghost notes appear, beats drift off-grid
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: stutter-house neon waveforms on matte fog gray

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick cooling droplets onto overheated swimmers before they sink in a shimmering European pool during peak heatwave.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: rescue streaks drain a visible heat-index bar — clear it before the timer boils over
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: more swimmers spawn, targets shrink, droplets evaporate mid-flight
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: washed watercolor heat shimmer with bleached summer tones

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one continuous scan line across a crumpled document before the page yellows and the text dissolves unread.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: a perfect one-stroke parse reveals a hidden word from the document — collect three per round
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: paper creases multiply, scan window shrinks, ink bleeds into the path
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: photocopy grain with pulsing OCR highlight boxes

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe agent outputs into matching feedback loops before they spiral — pair prompt fragments with their echo responses.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: closing a complete loop triggers a recursive bloom — chain three loops for a combo burst
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: loops nest inside loops, lanes multiply, echoes arrive out of order
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: recursive wireframe spirals on midnight blue
